facts.fact: L'Union reports a Libreville workshop opened 8 July 2024 to evaluate the plan of an education statistical yearbook, following a school data collection involving several administrations including the Direction generale de la Statistique.
The yearbook planned would draw on the school data collection covering pre-school and primary schools: establishments, desks, pupils and staff.
